connector.name: AdButler
connector.registryDescription: Manage AdButler campaigns, zones, ad items, VAST, and reports from Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.adbutler.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.adbutler. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ADBUTLER_API_KEY
env.description: Your AdButler API key. Get it from AdButler Dashboard → Settings → API Keys.
